frame.node_dir: outward unit normal of the mating face; GLB empty local +Y = dir

parts[].id: part id, e.g. tank00 (stable; never reused)
parts[].name: display name
parts[].category: category key = folder under models/ (cmd, prop, tank, stage, station, power, rover, jet, cockpit, aero, struct, robo, sci)
parts[].sizes: size labels of the variants, in file order (stack classes XS..XXL, adapters 'S-M', or labels like 'slot', 'Mk2', 'swept-S')
parts[].in_game_role: catalogue gameplay text (mass, power, crew, slots, rules)
parts[].variants[]: one entry per GLB (size x pose)

variants[].vid: variant id = GLB file stem; use this in craft files
variants[].state: 'flight' for the default pose, otherwise the pose name (deployed, stowed, open, steer_left, ...)
variants[].primary: true for the part's default variant
variants[].default_state: true when this is the default pose of its size
variants[].default_of: (poses) vid of the default pose this pose belongs to (shares its origin)
variants[].bbox_m: [x, y, z] bounding-box size in Godot axes (m)
variants[].dims: designer dimensions from nodes.json (diameters, lengths, slots, energy, ...)
variants[].dry_mass_t: (tanks) dry mass when the catalogue gives a dry fraction
variants[].mass_source: nodes.json dims.mass_t | catalogue in-game text | new_parts_spec key_dimensions.mass_t | estimate
variants[].mass_estimated: true = not a designed value (approximate catalogue figure, interpolated, or bbox-volume estimate): flag it in game data
variants[].slots: {provides: {small_units, text}} for slot bays, {occupies: {slot_class: Small|Medium|Rack, mount_node}} for slot items. 1 Small = 0.5 x 0.5 x 0.6 m; Medium = 2x2x1 units; Rack = 2x2x3 units
variants[].nodes[]: {name, pos [x,y,z] m, dir [x,y,z] unit} in the part's local Godot frame
variants[].meshes: named mesh nodes in the low-poly GLB (same names in the CAD GLB)
variants[].moving_meshes: meshes that move between poses (animate these; others are static)
variants[].materials_lowpoly: material names used (shared library, see AGENT_HANDOFF.md)
variants[].paths: repo-relative paths (glb_lowpoly default, glb_cad, nodes_json, thumbs), paths inside the two zips, suggested Godot res:// path
variants[].urls: raw.githubusercontent.com and GitHub Pages URLs for the GLBs and nodes.json, plus the web viewer link

schema v3 (AX line).parts[].line: product line: 'AX' for the AX line; absent on base-line parts (treat absent as 'base'). Filter with p.get('line', 'base') == 'AX'
schema v3 (AX line).parts[].display_id: human id, e.g. AX-cmd-01 (AX-<category>-<NN>, stable, never reused)
schema v3 (AX line).parts[].key: file-safe form of display_id (ax_cmd_01) = parts[].id; file stems and vids start with it
schema v3 (AX line).parts[].ax_category: AX category (cmd, prop, tank, stage, station, power, rover, aero, ...); 'category' is the site/folder category
schema v3 (AX line).parts[].batch, code, interior: AX build batch (B1..B10), designer code (e.g. CM-8), interior kind (full / none / ...)
schema v3 (AX line).parts[].aliases: old part ids this part replaces (modern_set: cmd11 -> ax_cmd_01, prop27-29 -> ax_prop_01-03, tank14/15 -> ax_tank_01/02)
schema v3 (AX line).parts[].redirects: {old vid: new vid} for those aliases
schema v3 (AX line).variants[].line: same as the part's line (AX variants only)
schema v3 (AX line).variants[].alias_of: old vid this variant replaces (aliased parts only)
schema v3 (AX line).variants[].slots.occupies (AX): AX slot items (nodes.json 'slot'): {slot_class Small|Medium|Rack, mount_node node_bottom}
schema v3 (AX line).variants[].slots.positions: AX slot bays: [{name, cls, node_bottom_mount [x,y,z] m, up, access?}] from nodes.json variants[].extra.slots
schema v3 (AX line).redirects: top-level map old id -> new id for both part ids and vids; resolve craft-file ids through it before lookup

versioning.manifest_version: semver of this parts release (X.Y.Z). Minor = parts/interiors added (or removed), patch = existing ones changed. Released only on request; see handoff/CHANGELOG.md and the git tag parts-vX.Y.Z
versioning.generated_at: ISO 8601 time the manifest was generated (box time, UTC+2)
versioning.parts[].sha256 / interiors[].sha256: {nodes_json: sha256 hex} of the part's nodes file
versioning.variants[].sha256: parts: {glb_lowpoly, glb_cad}; interiors: {glb_interior, glb_combined, glb_cutaway}: sha256 hex of each file
versioning.content_hash: per part / interior / assembly: sha256 over all its file hashes. Compare with your last import to detect changed files
versioning.meta_hash: per part / interior / assembly: sha256 over its manifest data except hashes, byte sizes and URLs (mass, nodes, text, slots, ...). Changes when only data changed

interiors[].exterior_part_id: the part this interior belongs to (parts[].id)
interiors[].name, reference, crew: display name, real-world reference, crew count
interiors[].frame: same origin and axes as the exterior GLB; node +Y = direction, node +Z = up (crew head / hatch up)
interiors[].exterior_hide: exterior mesh names to hide while the interior is shown
interiors[].moving_meshes: separate interior meshes that animate (hatch_door_N, stick_N, throttle_N, yoke_N, hand_controller_N*, canopy_frame_inner)
interiors[].hatches, windows, notes: as authored in the interior nodes JSON
interiors[].variants[]: {vid (<exterior vid>_interior), exterior_variant, state, primary, crew, nodes[] {name, pos, dir, up}, props[] {instance, prop, pos, basis_columns}, tris, bytes, paths, urls, sha256}

schema.interiors_skipped[]: {id, reason}: interiors that exist upstream but are not released yet

parts.name: PC-1 'Pathfinder' Probe Core
parts.summary: Minimal avionics puck for small satellites and landers.
parts.in_game_role: 0.08 t. 5 W idle. Hosts 2 internal slots (battery/computer). Basic SAS (stability only). Needs comms link for control beyond 2 km of a crewed vessel.
parts.real_life: CubeSat/SmallSat bus avionics (e.g. Blue Canyon XACT-class).

variants.label: Probe core puck
variants.notes: 2 x 0.5x0.5x0.6 m slots cannot physically fit in an XS puck; slot count is abstract

parts.name: PC-2 'Surveyor' Probe Bus
parts.summary: Hexagonal probe bus with internal bays for science, batteries and reaction wheels.
parts.in_game_role: 0.35 t. 4 internal slots, 15 W idle. Full SAS incl. prograde/target hold. Integrated 50 Nm reaction wheel.
parts.real_life: Generic planetary probe bus (MRO, Juno-class).

variants.label: Hexagonal probe bus
variants.notes: 4 open slot bays on alternate hex faces; reaction wheel housing on +Y face

parts.name: PC-3 'Voyager' Deep Space Bus
parts.summary: Large probe bus with RTG mounting points, heavy thermal control and long-life avionics.
parts.in_game_role: 1.1 t. 8 internal slots. Radiation-hardened: no avionics faults beyond Jupiter. Autonomy level 3 (executes stored manoeuvre plans without link).
parts.real_life: Cassini / Europa Clipper bus.

variants.label: Deep-space probe bus
variants.notes: decagonal Cassini-style bus; 8 slot-bay doors (0.5 x 0.6 m); 3 RTG mounting pads = node_side_1..3; node_top on the upper equipment module ring (HGA/stack)

parts.name: CM-1 'Gemini' Two-Seat Capsule
parts.summary: Cramped two-seat capsule for short LEO missions and early career.
parts.in_game_role: 2.3 t (approx). Crew 2. 3 internal slots. Life support 2 crew-days built in. Ablative shield rated for LEO re-entry only (~8 km/s).
parts.real_life: NASA Gemini.

variants.label: Gemini-class two-seat capsule
variants.notes: real Gemini base 2.3 m kept; S (1.25 m) is the cabin-top diameter; nose = R&R/RCS section

parts.name: CM-2 'Soyuz' Three-Seat Descent Module
parts.summary: Bell-shaped descent module; pairs with an orbital module and service module.
parts.in_game_role: 2.9 t. Crew 3. 4 internal slots. Semi-ballistic re-entry with lift offset. Soft-landing retro-rockets fire at 1 m above ground.
parts.real_life: Soyuz descent module.

variants.label: Soyuz-class descent module
variants.notes: Soyuz DM (2.17 m) scaled 1.15x to the M class; node_top = hatch to orbital module

parts.name: CM-3 'Dragon' Crew Capsule
parts.summary: Four-seat capsule with side-mounted abort engines and a nose-cone-covered docking port.
parts.in_game_role: 7.5 t dry (approx). Crew 4 (up to 7 in LEO config). 6 slots. Integrated abort engines (8x ~70 kN, hypergolic). Docking port under hinged nosecone.
parts.real_life: SpaceX Crew Dragon (SuperDraco abort system).

variants.label: Dragon-class crew capsule
variants.notes: nosecone is a separate mesh (hinge it open in Godot); node_top = docking port face under the nosecone

parts.name: CM-4 'Orion' Deep Space Capsule

parts.real_life: NASA Orion MPCV (with ESA European Service Module).

variants.label: Orion-class deep-space capsule
variants.notes: Orion CM 5.02 m -> 5.0 m; heat-shield sphere R = 1.5 D

parts.name: CM-5 'MAV' Ascent Cabin

parts.real_life: MAV from The Martian; NASA Mars Ascent Vehicle concepts.

variants.label: MAV ascent cabin
variants.notes: no heat shield; concept pill laid along the stack axis, cockpit windows below the docking nose

parts.name: CM-6 'Hermes' Flight Deck

parts.real_life: Hermes bridge (The Martian); ISS US Lab-style command functions.

variants.notes: bridge windows face -Y (front); berthing rings both ends; side nodes at 45/135/225/315 deg

parts.name: CM-7 'Lander' Crew Cabin

parts.name: DM-1 Hub Drive Motor

parts.in_game_role: Powers one wheel. Mounts on a steering module, suspension arm or directly on a rail; the matching rover04 wheel (S/M/L) fits node_outboard; XS is for micro rovers (needs a proposed 0.15 m rover04 XS wheel). Mass 0.3 / 4 / 15 / 60 kg.

parts.in_game_role: The probe core for rovers: drive computer, IMU, hazard cameras and autonomous navigation (drives waypoints without link). parts.in_game_role: Open seat for one suited crew member; mounts on any grid node. Includes a hand controller, so a seat plus a control core (or open cab) makes a drivable rover. Crew breathe from suits: range limited by suit consumables. Folds flat for launch. Mass 12 kg.

parts.in_game_role: Driving station for suited crew: console with nav display and comms relay (links suits to the rover antenna), roll-over protection and two seat nodes (take rover22 seats). Console top node takes an antenna mast or camera. 40 W. Mass 55 kg.

M: crew 2, 10 m3, built-in life support for 2 crew x 3 days, 4 Small + 1 Medium slots. L: crew 4 (2 sleep), 22 m3, 8 Small + 2 Medium + 1 Rack slot (fit LS-1 for long trips). 0.4 / 0.8 kW idle.
